text: EX-99.2 3 fnd-20260924x8kex992.htm EX-99.2 Document Exhibit 99.2 Floor & Decor Announces Board Leadership Transition Thomas Taylor to Transition from Executive Chair to Chair of the Board Lauren Taylor Wolfe to Join the Board of Directors ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--October 29, 2026-- Floor & Decor Holdings, Inc. (the “Company” or “Floor & Decor”) (NYSE: FND), a leading specialty retailer of hard surface flooring, today announced a series of changes to its Board of Directors. Effective January 1, 2027, Thomas Taylor, currently Executive Chair of the Board, will transition to the role of Chair of the Board. As part of a coordinated Board succession and refreshment process, the Board has appointed Lauren Taylor Wolfe as a new independent director, effective February 1, 2027. In addition, Norman Axelrod, the Company’s Lead Director, has informed the Board of his decision not to stand for reelection at the Company’s 2027 annual meeting of stockholders, expected to be held in May 2027. Mr. Axelrod will continue to serve as Lead Director through the annual meeting, at which point he will retire from the Board after 17 years of dedicated service. Mr. Taylor said, “This transition reflects the successful evolution of our leadership structure and the strong execution of our succession plan to Brad Paulsen, who has done an outstanding job stepping into the CEO role and building on the foundation we’ve spent years putting in place. Serving as Chair allows me to continue supporting the Board and the management team as we pursue our long-term growth strategy. We invited Lauren to join our Board as we believe she will bring strong complementary perspectives. I also want to thank Norman for his tremendous service on our Board. His guidance and steady hand have been invaluable to this Company and to me personally, and Floor & Decor is stronger today because of his contributions.” Mr. Paulsen said, “On behalf of the entire Floor & Decor team, I want to thank Tom for his continued partnership and mentorship, and for the extraordinary foundation he built over more than a decade leading this Company. I’m also deeply grateful to Norman for his years of thoughtful counsel and dedicated service to our Board. Finally, I’m excited to welcome Lauren to the Board. Her deep capital markets experience and track record of helping companies drive long-term value will be a great asset to Floor & Decor as we continue to grow our business.” Ms. Taylor Wolfe is Co-Founder and Managing Partner of Impactive Capital, an impact-oriented investment firm she co-founded in 2018 that partners with public companies to help drive long-term operational and strategic value for all stakeholders. Prior to founding Impactive Capital, she spent a decade at Blue Harbour Group, an investment management firm, where she served as a Managing Director and Investing Partner. She currently serves on the board of directors of WEX Inc. and has previously served on the boards of Envestnet, Inc. and HD Supply Holdings, Inc. Ms. Taylor Wolfe holds an M.B.A. from The Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania and a B.S., magna cum laude, from Cornell University. About Floor & Decor Holdings, Inc. Floor & Decor is a multi-channel specialty retailer of hard surface flooring and related accessories and seller of commercial surfaces. As of September 24, 2026, the Company operated 282 warehouse-format stores and five design studios across 39 states. The Company offers a broad in-stock assortment of laminate and vinyl, tile, wood, and natural stone flooring and installation materials and decorative accessories, as well as adjacent categories, at everyday low prices. The Company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
